candidate.answerReason: Factoring out the positive common factor \(2^{2012}\) gives \((4+1)/(4-1)=5/3\), agreeing with choice C.

methods.label: Factor out the smaller power
methods.explanation:
The exponents differ by \(2\), so
\[
2^{2014}=2^{2012}\cdot 2^2=4\cdot 2^{2012}.
\]
This lets us factor out the same large number from the numerator and denominator:
\[
\frac{2^{2014}+2^{2012}}{2^{2014}-2^{2012}}
=\frac{2^{2012}(4+1)}{2^{2012}(4-1)}
=\frac{5}{3}.
\]
The cancellation is valid because \(2^{2012}>0\); the denominator is \(3\cdot 2^{2012}>0\) as well. The value is \(\frac{5}{3}\), choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
